backend.title: Backend Engineer
backend.description: Implements server-side behavior, APIs, authorization, business rules, and focused tests.

frontend.title: Frontend Engineer
frontend.description: Implements accessible and responsive UI features following the project's design system.

frontend-tester.title: Frontend Tester
frontend-tester.description: Reviews browser workflows, accessibility, responsiveness, and interface regressions without changing application code.

database.title: Database Engineer
database.description: Designs schemas, queries, migrations, transactions, and data-integrity protections for the project database.

devops.title: DevOps / SRE Engineer
devops.description: Reviews and implements reproducible builds, CI/CD, observability, and safe deployment procedures.

integration-tester.title: Integration / Regression Tester
integration-tester.description: Tests cross-component workflows and failure modes using isolated fixtures and test data.

security.title: Security Specialist
security.description: Independently reviews attack surfaces, authentication, authorization, secrets, dependencies, and vulnerabilities.

performance.title: Performance Engineer
performance.description: Profiles and diagnoses latency, CPU, memory, I/O, concurrency and query performance.

ux-designer.title: UX Designer
ux-designer.description: Evaluates user flows, accessibility, design consistency, and interaction tradeoffs.

documentation.title: Documentation Engineer
documentation.description: Maintains user guides, API documentation, developer onboarding, and operational runbooks.

auditor-advisor.title: Independent Auditor / Advisor
auditor-advisor.description: Performs deep independent architecture, correctness, reliability, security and technical decision reviews.
